bugs.what: Hollow King marked 'hostile' but is actually friendly and cooperative

confusions: Only tested verse path; crown path mechanics unknown (alternative to reeve/priest conflict)
Political choice (seal vs open barrow) was presented implicitly in dialogue but the reeve/priest never react differently to sealing
Early game didn't clearly signal that both paths (verses or crown) lead to complete endings
suggestions: Clarify or remove 'hostile' status from Hollow King — he's cooperative
Show distinct reeve/priest reactions to whether barrow is sealed or left open to reinforce the choice
If verses collected early, hint at alternative crown path as viable endgame
